shortcutName.description: Shortcut name for the source file

launchArg.description: The startup parameters for the created shortcut

sourceFile.description: The file shortcut points to after recursive unzip, support regex contained by //

recursiveUnzipList.description: Directory or compressed files chain inside downloaded file, support regex contained by // (keep it a empty array if only downloaded file is needed to unzip)

addPath.description: Add the source file directory to the user PATH

addMachinePath.description: Add the source file directory to the machine PATH
